note: Majority: Civil Code of Mongolia (10 January 2002), in the English text WIPO Lex holds, Article 15.1: full civil capability arises on reaching 18; a court may grant it from 16 (Article 15.2), not held. A newer consolidated text wasn't reached (legalinfo.mn didn't answer). Service: the Ministry of Defence's page on conscript service says that, under the duty the Constitution sets every citizen, a Mongolian citizen who has reached 18 serves in person in the Armed Forces, border or internal troops, for 12 months, and that the upper age for conscript service is 26. The page doesn't say which sexes are called, and the Law on Military Service it rests on (legalinfo.mn, lawId 12124) couldn't be reached, so service is left null rather than guess the sexes; from 18, until 26 and 12 months are what the Ministry states. Work: not read; the Labour Law wasn't reached (legalinfo.mn didn't answer).

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Civil Code of Mongolia (English)
sources.said: 15.1. Civil legal capability to acquire rights and obligations by own conduct or full legal capacity emerges with reaching 18 or adolescence.

sources.title: Ministry of Defence of Mongolia, Хугацаат цэргийн алба (conscript service)
sources.said: 18 нас хүрсэн Монгол улсын иргэн Зэвсэгт хүчин, хилийн ба дотоодын цэрэгт биеэр алба хаана. Алба хаах хугацаа 12 сар ... иргэний хугацаат цэргийн алба хаах насны дээд хязгаар 26 байна.
